sites.name: Crescent Harbor
sites.notes: Seven numbered main walk floats; three gangways reported by ADFG; source map resolves slip IDs. Exact projected float geometry not yet obtained.

sites.name: ANB Harbor
sites.notes: Public harbor on Katlian waterfront. Do not substitute Crescent float geometry or assume free access to working facilities.

sites.name: Thomsen Harbor
sites.notes: Independent northern Katlian harbor; needs its own official float plan.

sites.name: Richard I. Eliason Sr. Harbor
sites.notes: Separate municipal marina north of Thomsen Harbor; no copying Crescent geometry.

sites.name: Sealing Cove Harbor
sites.notes: Japonski Island harbor west of O'Connell Bridge; obtain separate mapped floats.

sites.name: John O'Connell Memorial Bridge
sites.notes: 1972 cable-stayed girder-span structure with stays and pylons, not a generic ramp-only crossing. Library of Congress HAER AK-27 documents its identity.

sites.name: Fisherman's Quay / former Pyramid Packing Company
sites.notes: Historic buildings at 475 Katlian Street were built in 1918. Need present-day individual footprints, facades, changes and use verified before modeling.

sites.name: Andrew Hope Boat Shop
sites.notes: Historic Katlian shop: 1941 one-storey gable-front, vertical siding, corrugated metal roofing documented in preservation material. Verify condition and measured footprint.

sites.name: Japonski Island Boathouse
sites.notes: WWII-era Navy boat-repair building across bridge. Restoration plan is not evidence that planned addition exists today.

sites.name: Alaska Native Brotherhood Hall
sites.notes: Built in 1914 and expanded in 1928. Documented and culturally significant; identity does not grant interior modeling permission.

sites.name: Original Sitka Cold Storage
sites.notes: Original plant burned in 1973. NEVER place the historical building as a present-day waterfront structure; model the actual present parcel use separately only after new survey.

sites.name: Herring Rock original location
sites.notes: A preserved portion of the ancient Tlingit landmark was moved. Original and current placements must not be conflated.

sites.name: Noow Tlein (Castle Hill)
sites.notes: Tlingit cultural and historic landscape; no invented fort/building reconstruction or assumed public interior.
